messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — when I click through from the sidebar into the Serving Runtime guide it lands on a 404. The frontmatter canonical is set to /runtime/serving but the sidebar links to /serving-runtime. See the failing link: https://docs.internal.redwood.ai/serving-runtime -> 404.

link-checker-bot: Automated scan flagged 1 broken canonical/redirect mismatch in /docs/serving-runtime.md (HTTP 404). Rule: canonical != sidebar_url.

elaine: This is affecting the Dedicated quickstart flow where we deep-link to the serving section. Small but visible to customers during trials. Can we pick an owner to either update the frontmatter or add a redirect rule?

jamal: I can take this. Quick question: do we prefer canonical = /serving-runtime (match sidebar) or canonical = /runtime/serving (keep old path + redirect)?

elaine: Ideally minimize churn — easier to add a redirect for the short term, then update any external links later. But either works if we communicate.

jamal: OK. I'll add a redirect entry and also a tiny frontmatter patch to normalize paths. Will open a PR.

sasha: Thanks @jamal — can you include a note in the PR description saying which external shortlinks we should sweep? I can run a quick grep across marketing and onboarding templates.

jamal: Yep. PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood.ai/redwood/docs/pull/4822 — title: docs(serving): normalize canonical + add redirect from /serving-runtime -> /runtime/serving. Includes frontmatter change and netlify/_redirects entry.

dan: Quick nit: the site's redirect config expects trailing slashes. Make sure the redirect is `/serving-runtime/  /runtime/serving/ 301` (or use glob).

jamal: Good catch. Updated the redirect to keep trailing slashes and added a test in the preview deploy.

elaine: Preview deploy looks good for me. Sidebar links now route cleanly. :tada:

sasha: I ran the grep across templates — found 3 references in /playbooks/onboarding and 1 in the dedicated quickstart. I'll open a tiny batch PR to update those to the canonical path.

link-checker-bot: Re-scan complete — 0 failures for /docs/serving-runtime.md after latest deploy.

jamal: Merging after CI passes. Leaving @sasha and @elaine to coordinate external link updates.

elaine: Thanks all. If anyone else hits a similar mismatch, mention the bot scan and tag "docs" channel. Short note for release notes: docs: add redirect for serving-runtime -> runtime/serving.

sasha: adding a quick follow-up item in the docs backlog to add a lint rule preventing canonical/sidebar mismatch.

dan: Nice. That lint rule would have saved us time. +1 on doing it in the next docs sweep.
